WITH matched AS (
  SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, t.bandusagepct
  FROM telescopes AS t
  JOIN observatories AS o ON o.observstation = t.observstation
), station_averages AS (
  SELECT observstation, lunarstage, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct
  FROM matched
  GROUP BY observstation, lunarstage
), phase_stats AS (
  SELECT m.lunarstage,
         (SELECT AVG(sa.avg_bandusagepct)
          FROM station_averages AS sa
          WHERE sa.lunarstage IS m.lunarstage) AS avg_bandusagepct,
         COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
  FROM matched AS m
  GROUP BY m.lunarstage
)
SELECT lunarstage,
       avg_bandusagepct,
       telescope_count,
       1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total
FROM phase_stats;
